judgements.justification: A's Reviewer_oDAB criticised reproducibility on a misread SNGAN FID of 21.7 (Table 3 gives 14.70; 21.74 is SNGAN-SPADE); B had no such error, though oDAB's other points hold.
B's AC gave a spotlight on a 7.0 mean with a single 8, and the meta-review overstates consensus ('all agree ... novel', while kHDT called it 'a straightforward follow-up').
B's Reviewer_7vAs ('not an expert', confidence 3) gave 7 on two sentences of praise, and that 7 counted in B's 7.0 mean.

Only on A's forum did the authors concede that CoPE and Π-Net 'could learn a similar model', that not all polynomials are representable and that gradients are not bounded; B got a list of differences instead.
B knew of the Π-Net closeness and the missing state-of-the-art comparison; Rugm called his declined requests 'fully addressed' and the meta-review called the work novel.
Three of B's reviewers raised their scores after the rebuttal (tbWn, Rugm, kHDT); none of A's scores moved.
Only A's Reviewer_41qE showed Eq. 2 is Π-Net on the concatenated input and asked for an ablation; only A's Mncu checked bolded gains against the standard deviations.
Both committees saw the closeness to Π-Net and the lack of state-of-the-art baselines; A rejected on them, while B read the closeness as 'a natural continuation'.
A's AC followed three concordant detractors, not one reviewer; B's AC followed all four ratings.
Every score change in B cites the rebuttal; no reviewer moved because of the other reviews.
The authors answered every reviewer, including 41qE's follow-up; no misreading held a score down.
B's Reviewer_7vAs gave 7 on assertion and never commented after the rebuttal, and that score counted unchallenged; A's thin 7 (La4a) was discounted by its AC.
A's AC rejected with three of four ratings below threshold (4, 5, 4).
Neither AC stated a positive view that a score threshold overrode.
A's low scores rest on core novelty and experimental concerns, not peripheral points.
Both committees judged the paper as a methods contribution extending Π-Net; they weighed its novelty differently.
B's raisers (tbWn, Rugm, kHDT) did not say the core was outside their expertise; the self-declared non-expert (7vAs) did not raise.
The difference is in which concerns each committee raised and how it weighed them, not in a different bar for one paper type.
B's Reviewer_7vAs rated 7 on 'clear improvements over baselines', which fails for CIFAR10 (Table 3 gains below one standard deviation).
No A reviewer acknowledged that the rebuttal resolved their main concern; 41qE kept the novelty objection, and Mncu and oDAB stayed silent.
B credited tables delivered in the rebuttal, not promises, and A's committee did not state a refusal to credit promised changes.
No reviewer stated a changed position without editing the score.
No extra reviewer was called in.
Clarity was not a point of difference between the committees.
B's three raisers each gave a stated reason for raising.
A's AC discounted a silent champion (La4a's 7), not a silent detractor.
B's only 8 (Rugm) accepted declined requests as 'fully addressed' and did not argue for the paper in discussion; A also had a 7.
No reviewer admitted reading only part of the paper.
No reviewer contested the premise from another theoretical tradition.
B's meta-review argues only for acceptance and gives no reason for the spotlight.
B's reviewers also knew the prior work (Rugm cited Karras et al. 2020; kHDT called the paper a follow-up of Π-Net) and questioned the baselines.

reasoning: The stage 1 verdict says the committees weighted the same facts differently (R08), and only A tested the novelty claim against Π-Net (R07), drawing concessions that B never saw (R04). B's concerns were requests a rebuttal could answer, so three B reviewers raised while A's scores held (R06). B's ratings include a thin, inattentive 7 resting on a wrong claim of clear gains (R03, R12, R19), and its AC gave a spotlight with no stated case and an overstated consensus (R02, R30). B treated known gaps as resolved (R05). oDAB's misread FID is a minor wrong claim in A (R01). The candidate 'rebuttal answers clarifications, not novelty' is the cause behind R06 together with R07, so no new reason was added.
